readback: Registration keeps the existing tokens response field as the system session for compatibility and adds platformTokens for the independent platform session.
The creator is stored into both contexts and lands directly in /systems/{systemId}/admin.
Registration conflicts now leave no second account/system and persist ACCOUNT_REGISTER_SYSTEM_CREATED / RESOURCE_CONFLICT in a separate audit transaction.
Session expiry values are serialized with an explicit UTC offset derived from the server Clock zone, so browser expiry checks are based on an unambiguous instant.
The API client refreshes only the matching platform or system scope, deduplicates concurrent refreshes, stores rotated tokens and retries the failed request once.
